title: Verify indicator-type mapping through DHIS2 global metadata settings
problem: Issue #1255 requests remapping indicator types when source and target DHIS2 instances use different definitions. The original Global Mapping UI omits the type in a browser probe; an existing category mapping selects, saves and reloads with synthetic services. Actual destination import semantics remain unverified.
humanitarian_relevance: MetaData Sync is explicitly recommended in WHO malaria repository guidance. Reliable mapping could reduce integration work, but contribution-specific time savings and deployment are unverified.

evidence.claim: Issue #1255 attributes an indicator-type mapping gap to CHAI/UiO work and says it remained unbuilt in July 2026. No Humanifest acceptance is present.

At the pinned development revision, InstanceMappingPage global.models lists seven model classes and no indicator-type model. This is a static source observation, not a runtime reproduction or proof of every mapping path.

Seven isolated checks run the unchanged MappingMapper and original metadata helpers with schema-only adapters and published DHIS2 2.40 schemas. Supplied mappings rewrite indicator-type references; included source type objects receive destination IDs while retaining source fields. Inputs and pinned files remain unchanged. No full app, persistence or server-import behavior is established.

Thirteen unchanged native metadata tests and four additional original-code probes pass with network denied. The original factory resolves indicator types; the builder includes the source type; the mapper retains source fields under the destination ID; mapping round-trips through the original repository with memory storage. All 898 pinned source files remain unchanged after restoring one installer-generated translation template. Those native checks do not test browser behavior or actual DHIS2 import.

The original Global Mapping UI rendered seven options without indicator types in the in-app browser. A synthetic category mapping selected destination A, survived full reload with its picker selection restored, then changed to B and survived another reload. Original apply/get/save use cases and repository ran with synthetic metadata and browser localStorage boundaries. All 898 original source files remain unchanged; no DHIS2 storage/import or deployed benefit is established.

code_surface: At 78c8b8c22278dcbb7d2d5678eaafaa80b0fd0cf9: InstanceMappingPage global selector omits indicator types; modelFactory registers IndicatorTypeModel; MetadataSyncUseCase invokes MappingMapper before repository save. Thirteen unchanged payload-builder/integration tests and four native workflow probes passed. Original page, picker, mapping use cases and repository also exercised in the in-app browser with synthetic service/storage boundaries.
proposed_change: If maintainers accept the contribution, add indicator types to the existing global mapping workflow with regression coverage for reference rewriting, mapping persistence and agreed included-type semantics. Agree whether destination types are reused unchanged, excluded from import or updated; do not widen global import defaults.
research_next_step: Prepare a concise scope inquiry for human review: confirm that the original missing indicator-type option is still wanted, agree destination-type reuse versus update semantics and AI/bot contribution eligibility. Reference the browser control and native probes; do not change global import defaults or contact maintainers before review.
tests: 13 unchanged upstream tests pass (10 payload-builder, 2 metadata synchronization, 1 local mapping), plus four native probes of original factory, mapper, builder and repository with synthetic metadata/memory storage. Network denial verified by EPERM control. Earlier seven schema-adapter checks also passed. No whole suite, type check or server import. Original browser control verifies the missing selector option and category selection/save/reload/replacement through actual mapping code with synthetic metadata and localStorage; this is manual browser evidence, not an automated UI suite or DHIS2 datastore test.
environment: Isolated Node 22.22.0 and immutable Yarn 4.12.0 setup; lockfile TypeScript 4.9.5, Vitest 3.2.4, lodash 4.18.1. 1974 packages installed with no inherited credentials. Dependency scripts disabled, but workspace localization ran; missing msgmerge warned and generated en.pot was preserved then restored. All 898 pinned files verified after tests. Future installs use --mode=skip-build; tests run under OS network denial. Synthetic UI bundle built with network denied, then served only on loopback with CSP connect-src none. Initial envDir:false was corrected to the empty probe env directory after inspecting Vite 4 behavior; rebuilt bundle rechecked. Full application build remains unverified.
maintainer: Issue #1255 is open and unassigned with zero comments; inspected timeline has project events and no linked PR. No scope or AI/bot confirmation. No outreach sent or follow-up date invented.
risks: Native builder and mapper include source type fields under the mapped destination ID; actual target updates remain untested. Original importer defaults permit updates, but DHIS2 documentation notes MERGE limitations, so reuse/update semantics need confirmation. Indicator-type UI behavior after a future change, actual DHIS2 storage/import, AI/bot eligibility, accepted scope and real benefit remain unresolved.
priority_rationale: Cause-led selection links WHO malaria integration guidance to a current, narrow public request. Investigate it independently while other organizations review existing inquiries; do not equate issue age or activity with impact.

behavior_reproducible_or_verifiable.rationale: Native original factory/builder/mapper/repository behavior is verified, and the original global selector omission and category mapping control are reproduced in the in-app browser with synthetic services/storage. Actual destination import remains untested.

regression_strategy_credible.rationale: Reusable original-code probes now cover builder inclusion, reference rewriting, retained source fields and mapping repository round-trip, alongside 13 passing upstream tests. Accepted semantics and UI/server checks remain to agree.

no_private_data_required.rationale: The selected mapping question can be investigated with synthetic metadata identifiers and indicator definitions. No patient records or operational instances are needed.

Full contribution/license eligibility remains unconfirmed. Workspace localization ran despite disabled dependency scripts, and its generated file was restored; do not repeat a claim that all scripts were disabled.

maintainer_interest_confirmed.rationale: No Humanifest inquiry or explicit acceptance; open unassigned issue is not maintainer confirmation.

probable_reviewer_identified.rationale: Issue author and PR template are known, but no reviewer has accepted this contribution.

user_can_explain_line_by_line.rationale: No production patch or independent human code review exists.

score_basis: Native baseline, original-code workflow probes and the original browser selector/control strengthen technical confidence. Accepted scope, actual destination effect and deployment remain unverified; implementation score is zero.
